page_title: MNU 3-2 IPS | Manchester Utd v Ipswich 26/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
90+7' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) is penalised for holding. Darren England signals a set piece.
90+5' Jack Taylor (Ipswich) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
90+3' Ruben Amorim has decided to substitute Leny Yoro and he is replaced by Victor Lindelof (Manchester United).
90+3' Ruben Amorim has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) replacing Joshua Zirkzee.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) comes onto the pitch for Jens Cajuste.
90+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
89' Flag up against Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

88' A neat pass is well received by Jaden Philogene (Ipswich), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
87' Alex Palmer leaps to intercept the corner kick from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).
85' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Darren England ignores the protests.
85' Liam Delap (Ipswich) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.

84' The corner lands on the head of George Hirst (Ipswich) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post.
84' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
84' The corner from Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) is hurriedly cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Ipswich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich).
80' Here is a change. Axel Tuanzebe is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich).
80' The referee signals a substitution. George Hirst is brought on as a substitute for Leif Davis (Ipswich).
79' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) tries to find Noussair Mazraoui, but he puts too much power on the pass.
78' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
74' Jack Taylor (Ipswich) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
74' Ipswich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
71' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) sends a cross into the box, but Andre Onana comes off his line to gather the ball.
67' It will be a substitution. Casemiro (Manchester United) is ready to enter the pitch as Rasmus Hojlund walks off.
66' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Nathan Broadhead.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jack Taylor (Ipswich) will replace Samy Morsy.
65' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jaden Philogene.
65' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
63' The game is interrupted. Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
61' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
61' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jens Cajuste (Ipswich). Darren England saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
60' We are about to witness a substitution. George Hirst (Ipswich) is replacing Leif Davis.
60' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
59' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ipswich.

58' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jaden Philogene (Ipswich). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Ipswich will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
55' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
55' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
54' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
53' Darren England interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich).
51' The resulting set piece from Ipswich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

47' 3 - 2 The ball was swung into the box by Bruno Fernandes from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Harry Maguire (Manchester United), who planted a bullet header inside the left post to make the score 3:2.
47' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner.

47' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' That's a clear yellow card. Dara O'Shea (Ipswich) goes into the book.
45+4' Darren England shows a yellow card to Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45+3' 2 - 2 Jaden Philogene (Ipswich) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Substitution. Alejandro Garnacho will be replaced by Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United).
43' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Darren England produces a RED card from his pocket and Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) heads for an early shower!

41' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United), but referee Darren England must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
40' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
38' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
37' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
37' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots goalwards, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Alex Palmer. What a save!
35' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Samy Morsy (Ipswich) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
26' 2 - 1 Goal! Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top left corner. It's 2:1.

26' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Alex Palmer pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the middle of the target.
26' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
26' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
25' One of the Ipswich players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
24' The ball is cleared after Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
23' 1 - 1 OWN GOAL! The free kick is whipped in and Samy Morsy (Ipswich) is unlucky enough to head the ball into his own net. 1:1.
21' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Manchester Utd will take a free kick.
20' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Darren England saw the whole situation.
19' The Manchester Utd players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
17' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
16' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
15' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
15' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes it short.
13' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) brings his opponent down. Darren England has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Liam Delap (Ipswich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
12' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
10' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the top right corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
10' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
9' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Manchester Utd have a corner.
8' Liam Delap (Ipswich) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Darren England who sees an offensive foul.
8' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
7' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
7' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Leif Davis (Ipswich), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Jaden Philogene (Ipswich), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
4' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' Darren England blows his whistle. Jack Clarke (Ipswich) commits a foul after dangerous play.
1' Liam Delap (Ipswich) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Ipswich will have the kick-off.
Darren England got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
